text:
Alex: Heads up — there's a half-open box of bagels in the pantry with my name on it (ALEX). If you grabbed one, please put the rest back + note in the kitchen whiteboard. Also does anyone want me to run out for more around 3:30?

Maya: Oops no idea. the mystery bagel thief strikes again :ghost: I can swing by at 3:30 if you want — everything ok to buy plain + sesame?

Sam: Plain + everything for me. Also fridge ghosting: my yogurt vanished this morning, label said SAM. Not cool. :unamused:

Jen: i'll put a sticky note dispenser near the fridge. whoever takes unmarked stuff owes a round of coffee.

Kyle: can we start a sticker system? different color for each team? :thinking_face:

Morgan: I vote post-it + tiny marker by the door. Also happy to chip in for bagels.

Alex: sweet — Maya if you can, get 2 plain, 2 everything, 1 sesame? total 5. i'll paypal you when i get back.

kitchen-bot: inventory update: pantry_bagels=3, coffee_pods=24, milk_cartons=2. Temp sensor: fridge=3.8C.

Maya: confirmed. dropping by now. who wants butter vs cream cheese?

Sam: cream cheese pls. thanks!

Jen: butter for me. and small paper plates if available.

Kyle: can someone add 'label your food' to the #office-notes board? quick reminder avoids drama lol.

Alex: last: if anyone sees a blue Tupperware labelled 'Morgan' — it's fine to borrow but please put back by end of day :pray:

Morgan: noted. thanks all.
